title: Anglia Expands Analogue Supply Strategy
summary: Anglia Components announced a strategy to supply the entire signal chain to address customer frustration regarding analogue component supply.

title: Elektrobit and Microchip Streamline AUTOSAR
summary: The collaboration combines EB tresos software with Microchip automotive platforms to streamline AUTOSAR software development.

title: FF Launches Nova Humanoid Robots
summary: FF launched Nova humanoid robots and Physical AI programs featuring developer tools, educational curricula, and reinforcement learning.

title: IBM and Siemens Collaborate on 3D Nanostacks
summary: IBM and Siemens will develop virtual models, simulation, and lithography techniques to advance 3D nanostack technology.

title: IonQ and Cavendish Lab Open Quantum Centre
summary: IonQ and Cambridge University's Cavendish Lab have opened the IonQ Quantum Innovation Centre at the Ray Dolby Centre.

title: Cincoze Launches External EMC Protection Module
summary: Cincoze has launched the Power Protection Module to strengthen protection against electromagnetic noise in industrial environments.

title: Airbus U740-Valkyrie Completes Maiden Flight
summary: Airbus's uncrewed combat aircraft U740-Valkyrie successfully completed its maiden flight in Northern Europe.

title: Rocket Lab Delays Neutron Debut to 2027
summary: Rocket Lab has postponed the launch of its Neutron vehicle due to carbon fibre manufacturing problems.

title: Sikorsky Packs Nomad 100 VTOL Squad in Box
summary: Sikorsky introduced the Fast Pack system, housing four Nomad 100 VTOL drones and gear inside a 20-foot shipping container.

title: Wireless Optoelectronics Enable Local Gene Control
summary: Researchers developed wireless implantable optoelectronic devices to enable local, light-regulated gene activation in mouse lungs.

title: Remote Control of Cu Sites Enhances Methane Conversion
summary: Outer-shell coordination engineering in Zr-based metal-organic frameworks enables remote control of single-atom Cu reactivity for methane hydroxylation.

title: SpaceX Launches Classified US Space Force Mission
summary: SpaceX launched a classified mission for the U.S. Space Force from California, marking its 114th Falcon 9 mission of the year.

title: LIBERO-PeRM Benchmark for Personalized Robotic Manipulation
summary: Researchers introduced LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark and simulation framework for preference learning in personalized robotic manipulation.

title: Value as Memory Improves General Robot Policies
summary: Value as Memory is a framework using value caching and online reinforcement learning that improves robot policy success rates on long-horizon tasks.

title: Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Manipulation
summary: Researchers introduced P3-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that combines 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning.

title: GeoState Framework for View-Decoupled 3D World Modeling
summary: GeoState is a view-decoupled geometry representation that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation for predictive 3D world modeling.

title: Spark-0 Spatially Aligned Tactile Pretraining for Robots
summary: Spark-0 is a vision-tactile-language-action model that uses touch data for scalable supervision in contact-rich robot dexterous manipulation.

title: Modeling Emotion Spread and Decision-Making in Networks
summary: A new Laplacian-based flow framework models emotional contagion in social networks and its effects on consensus, polarization, and decision-making.

title: Illumination-Aware Active Perception for Spacecraft Inspection
summary: A new spacecraft inspection planning framework replaces geometric visibility with a learned camera information measure to account for harsh orbital lighting.

title: Mem4Act Latent Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Control
summary: Mem4Act is a framework for learning fixed-size latent memory optimized for long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks.

title: Targeted Active Preference Learning for Reward Recovery
summary: An informed prior approach and explanation method targets preference queries at underspecified features to improve reward recovery and reduce human effort.

title: Vaonis Unveils Atlas Modular Smart Telescope System
summary: Vaonis has opened pre-orders for the Atlas, the world's first modular smart telescope system featuring two optical tubes.

title: Auditable Multi-Agent Motion Planning via Posetal Games
summary: A new motion planning framework uses posetal games derived from legal guidelines to coordinate multi-agent interactions such as maritime navigation.

title: Philips Ultrasound Glitch Linked to Four Patient Deaths
summary: A software glitch and unstable cable connection in the Philips Lumify Ultrasound locked clinicians out of scanning, prompting an FDA alert.

title: Autonomous Motion Planning for Lunar Propulsive Drones
summary: Researchers proposed a vision-guided optimal control framework for safe and fuel-efficient hops between waypoints on the Moon.

title: Vaonis Launches Modular Smart Telescope with Swappable Optics
summary: The new Atlas telescope lets users swap optics like camera lenses while utilizing built-in tracking technology.

title: Preemptive Communication Improves Multi-Agent Pursuit Safety
summary: A new unified control and communication strategy guarantees inter-agent collision avoidance while reducing message transmissions by 77.5%.

title: Inertially Significant Humanoid Teleoperation via WB-MPC
summary: Researchers integrated whole body model predictive control with an extended Kalman filter for online estimation of time-varying inertial parameters in humanoids.

title: NASA SkyFall Helicopters to Explore Mars
summary: Mars helicopters will cover distance quickly and access areas impossible to reach by ground.

title: Data Orchestration for Semiconductor Enterprises
summary: Data orchestration unifies disconnected equipment and systems for semiconductor engineering teams without replacing existing infrastructure.
